contentText: Since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022, EU member states have provided around €200 billion in aid to Ukraine, making them its largest contributors ahead of the United States. Germany leads in total financial contributions, with around €54 billion, roughly twice France's €27 billion. But the picture changes when aid is measured against GDP or per capita, with Denmark and other Nordic countries ranking among the biggest contributors.
